(7 October) |attendance=1,260,207| average attendance = 21,003 | prevseason = [[2015 Indian Super League|2015]] | nextseason = [[2017–18 Indian Super League|2017–18]] | updated = | dates = 1 October – 18 December }} The '''2016 Indian Super League season''' was the third season of the [[Indian Super League]], the [[association football|football]] league, since its establishment in 2013. The season featured eight teams again, each playing 14 matches during the regular season before the finals. The regular season began on 1 October and ended on 4 December. The finals began on 10 December and concluded with the final on 18 December.{{cite web|title=2016 ISL Fixtures and Results|url=http://www.indiansuperleague.com/isl-2016/schedules-fixtures|website=Indian Super League|access-date=1 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161109234315/http://www.indiansuperleague.com/isl-2016/schedules-fixtures|archive-date=9 November 2016|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}} The defending champions coming into the season were [[Chennaiyin FC|Chennaiyin]]. At the end of the season, [[Atlético de Kolkata]] were crowned champions after defeating the [[Kerala Blasters FC|Kerala Blasters]] in a penalty shootout, 4–3, during the [[2016 Indian Super League final|final]].
